top_offers.title: Founding AI Engineer
top_offers.why: Founding-level AI engineering role building multi-agent systems from customer voice data at a YC seed startup, a strong AI-augmented engineering signal with genuine build-from-zero ownership. Onsite in New York rather than remote or Switzerland is the main drawback against the location preference.

top_offers.title: Founding Engineer (Full Stack)
top_offers.why: Full-stack founding engineer at an early-stage YC-backed AI startup, high ownership over architecture and technical direction echoes the Alaya founding experience. Remote but US-oriented, and compensation and equity terms are unclear.

top_offers.title: Founding AI/ML Research Engineer
top_offers.why: Founding research-engineer role applying ML/AI research to production at a YC startup, the strongest AI/LLM exposure in today's batch. Leans more research than platform engineering and is US remote rather than Europe-friendly.

top_offers.title: Founding Engineer / Builder
top_offers.why: Founding engineer role blending product thinking with full-stack execution at an early-stage YC company, with genuine build-from-zero scope. Remote is only available for exceptional candidates, with SF the default expectation.

top_offers.title: Staff Engineer, Software Release and Packaging (RISC-V)
top_offers.why: Staff-level role at a well-funded AI hardware startup, but the scope, release and packaging pipelines for RISC-V, sits outside the TypeScript/Node/platform stack and is closer to embedded systems work than product platform engineering.

top_offers.title: Senior/Staff Backend Engineer
top_offers.why: Staff-level backend and platform role at a YC-backed logistics-tech startup with real infrastructure ownership. Remote is US-based rather than Europe-friendly, and the freight-audit domain is a stretch from the target mission areas.
